verdict: Claude Haiku 5.5 for most forms and invoices; Claude Opus 5.5 when every field must be right. Claude Haiku 5.5 scored 0.98 on W-2 forms and 0.79 on RealKIE invoices for about half the cost of the default, Claude Sonnet 5 (0.96 and 0.80). Claude Opus 5.5, OpenAI GPT-6 Astra and xAI Grok 4.6 were nearly perfect on W-2s (0.999); Claude Sonnet 5.5 scored below Claude Sonnet 5 there (0.92). On RealKIE invoices no model scored measurably different from the default. The Amazon Nova models scored 0.06 to 0.16 lower on W-2s. xAI Grok 4.6 took about three times as long per document.
